findings.issue: The reported result says residual is null, while the final orchestrator log records three residuals after the final changes.
findings.fix: After every final fix, rerun an independent final reviewer and reconcile its findings into result residuals before declaring completion.

findings.issue: The unit/build gate missed animation and styling gaps that the completeness critic found; CSS inventory only proves source presence, not rendered behavior.
findings.fix: Add a dedicated browser/rendering verifier after integration and again after final fixes. Exercise every animation in normal and reduced-motion modes, plus overdue visual distinction and the manual performance proxy; use data-anim timing as an assertion aid, not CSS counts as the oracle.

findings.issue: Known fake-timer failures were accepted as unrelated by task reviews, then the aggregate verifier found 29 failed tests, 16 type errors, and a failed build.
findings.fix: Assign test-runtime/configuration ownership immediately after scaffold; require its focused regression suite before parallel feature work. At each integrated-wave boundary, run the full test, type-check, and build gate; route any failure to that owner instead of permitting a passing per-task verdict with red tests.

findings.issue: One catch-all final fixer absorbed test configuration, persistence, test-query, component wiring, and animation work, while the board/DnD task was also unusually concentrated.
findings.fix: Split cross-cutting work into ordered owners: test infrastructure before feature waves; board/DnD integration before application wiring; then functional verification, visual verification, and independent final re-review. Do not use a single final-fixer to close both verification classes.
